analyses_succeeded_is_complete.name: analyses_succeeded_is_complete
analyses_succeeded_is_complete.value:
status <> 'succeeded' OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND revision IS NOT NULL
        AND analysis_date IS NOT NULL AND baseline_status IS NOT NULL
        AND scanner_version IS NOT NULL)

api_tokens_kind_check.name: api_tokens_kind_check
api_tokens_kind_check.value:
(kind = 'personal' AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND project_id IS NULL)
        OR (kind = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id IS NULL
            AND scopes = ARRAY['analysis:write']::text[])

compliance_reports_scope_check.name: compliance_reports_scope_check
compliance_reports_scope_check.value: (scope = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL) OR (scope = 'organization' AND project_id IS NULL)

compliance_reports_ready_check.name: compliance_reports_ready_check
compliance_reports_ready_check.value: status <> 'ready' OR (data IS NOT NULL AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND summary IS NOT NULL AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND size_bytes IS NOT NULL)

identities_subject_length.name: identities_subject_length
identities_subject_length.value: subject IS NULL OR char_length(subject) BETWEEN 1 AND 255

identities_subject_or_scim_check.name: identities_subject_or_scim_check
identities_subject_or_scim_check.value: subject IS NOT NULL OR scim_user_name IS NOT NULL

generated.as: CASE severity WHEN 'blocker' THEN 0 WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'low' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

review_runs_reason_by_status.name: review_runs_reason_by_status
review_runs_reason_by_status.value: CASE status WHEN 'skipped' THEN reason IS NOT NULL AND reason IN ('no_snapshot','snapshot_rejected','draft','closed','inactive','empty_diff','unchanged','budget_spent') WHEN 'failed' THEN reason IS NOT NULL AND reason IN ('provider_error','provider_no_tools','bad_answer','internal') ELSE reason IS NULL END

review_snapshot_files_omitted_has_no_tex.name: review_snapshot_files_omitted_has_no_text
review_snapshot_files_omitted_has_no_tex.value: text IS NULL OR omitted IS NULL

review_snapshot_files_deleted_has_no_tex.name: review_snapshot_files_deleted_has_no_text
review_snapshot_files_deleted_has_no_tex.value: change IS DISTINCT FROM 'deleted' OR text IS NULL

scm_connections_github_app_check.name: scm_connections_github_app_check
scm_connections_github_app_check.value: (provider = 'gitlab' AND app_id IS NULL) OR (provider = 'github' AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id ~ '^[0-9]{1,20}$')

sso_connections_secret_check.name: sso_connections_secret_check
sso_connections_secret_check.value: (protocol = 'oidc' AND sp_key_enc IS NULL) OR (protocol = 'saml' AND secret_enc IS NULL)

sso_group_mappings_project_role_check.name: sso_group_mappings_project_role_check
sso_group_mappings_project_role_check.value: project_id IS NULL OR role IN ('project_admin','member','viewer')
